title: Alweda Alweda Alweda
body:
Alweda alweda alweda
Aye sibte payambar Alweda alweda alweda
1. Kuch kar na sake hum jee bhar ke ziyafat Phir rehgayi hasrat Alweda alweda alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Aye lashkare jarrar zainab ki aye talwaar
Abbase alamdaar Alweda alweda alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jaane dile madar shabbier ke dilbar
Ham shakle payambar Alweda alweda alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kubra hui’n bewa do lamho’n ka dulha
Aye qasime noushah Alweda alweda alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aye bolte quraa’n aye faqre rasulaa’n
Aye shahe shaheedaa’n Alweda alweda alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Garden teri aur teer aye nanhe se shabbier
Aye asghare besheer Alweda alweda alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jaane se tumhaare ab na rahi rounaq Aur hogaye dil shaq Alweda alweda alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hai gham hamei’n behad aye faqre abo jad
Aye aon o mohammad Alweda alweda alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aye qwahare masoom jaane shahe mazloom
Aye zainab o kulsoom Alweda alweda alweda
Kalaam : Ustaad e Suqan Janab Hassan Abidi Sahab
